privacy.contactBody: Have questions about your privacy? We're here to help.
privacy.heroBody: This Privacy Policy explains how HisabBoi collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our app and services. By using HisabBoi, you agree to the terms described below.

accountRows: To identify your account and personalize your experience
For account login, password reset, and notifications
To display in the app and to other business members
deviceList: Device type, OS version (for crash reporting and compatibility)
IP address (for security and fraud prevention)
Push notification tokens (to send you alerts)
financialRows: To organize and analyze your finances
To manage multiple accounts (personal, company, mess)
To calculate mess member costs and settlements
To track who owes what in shared accounts
s1.notCollectBody: payment card numbers, bank credentials, government ID, precise GPS location, contacts, photos, or microphone/camera data.
s1.title: 1. Information We Collect

s10.body1: HisabBoi is primarily designed for users in Bangladesh. Your data may be processed and stored on servers located outside your country. By using our app, you consent to such transfers.
s10.body2: We ensure that all data transfers comply with applicable data protection laws and that your data receives the same level of protection regardless of where it is processed.
s10.title: 10. International Data Transfers

s11.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will:
list: Update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page
Send a notification through the app
For significant changes, ask for your consent before continuing
s11.outro: Your continued use of HisabBoi after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
s11.title: 11. Changes to This Policy

s2.highlight: We process your financial data only to provide the services you request. We never use your financial data for advertising purposes.
s2.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
list: Provide core services — manage your books, calculate mess summaries, generate invoices
Account management — create and manage your account and business profiles
Collaboration — share relevant data with members you invite to your business
AI-powered insights — analyze financial data to provide personalized suggestions
Security — detect fraud, prevent abuse, and maintain account safety
Improvements — understand usage patterns to improve features and fix bugs
Communication — send transactional emails and important notifications
Legal compliance — meet our obligations under applicable laws
s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information

s3.intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We share data only in limited cases:
s3.legalBody: We may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or to protect our legal rights or the safety of our users.
s3.title: 3. Data Sharing & Third Parties
s3.warn: We never share your personal financial data with advertisers, data brokers, or marketing companies.
withinAppList: Business members you invite can see shared transaction data and balances
Mess members can see their own meal counts and dues
You control who is invited to your businesses

s4.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
list: Encryption in transit — all data transmitted over HTTPS/TLS
Encryption at rest — your data is encrypted in our database
Password hashing — passwords hashed using bcrypt; we never store plaintext
JWT authentication — secure token-based authentication with expiry
Access controls — only authorized users can access their own business data
Regular reviews — we regularly review and update our security practices
s4.outro: While we take strong measures to protect your data, no system is 100% secure. Please keep your credentials confidential and log out on shared devices.
s4.title: 4. Data Security

s5.outro: When you delete your account, we will permanently delete your personal data within 30 days, except where required by law.
rows: Until account is deleted by user
Until business or account is deleted
Until business or account is deleted
Up to 30 days after deletion request
s5.title: 5. Data Retention

s6.highlight: Account Deletion: Go to Settings → Delete Account, or visit our data deletion page. All your data will be permanently removed within 30 days.
list: Access — view all data we hold about you in the app
Correction — update your profile information anytime in Settings
Deletion — delete your account and all data from Settings → Delete Account
Data export — contact us to request a copy of your data
Opt-out — disable push notifications in your device settings
Object — object to certain data processing by contacting us
s6.title: 6. Your Rights & Choices

howList: In the app: Settings → Delete Account
Via web: visit our data deletion request page at {{appUrl}}/data-deletion
Via email: send a request to {{email}}
s7.intro: You may request full deletion of your account and data at any time. Upon deletion:
list: Your profile, email, and account credentials are permanently removed
All businesses you own and their transactions are deleted
Meal records, invoices, and mess data are deleted
Your membership in other users' businesses is removed
Backups are purged within 30 days
s7.title: 7. Account & Data Deletion
s7.warn: Account deletion is permanent and irreversible. Please export any data you need before deleting.

s8.body1: HisabBoi is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
s8.contact: If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately at {{email}}. We will promptly delete such information.
s8.title: 8. Children's Privacy

s9.intro: The HisabBoi mobile app does not use browser cookies. We may use the following technologies:
list: JWT tokens — stored securely on your device for authentication
Local storage — to cache your data for offline access
Push notification tokens — to deliver notifications to your device
Anonymized analytics — to understand app usage and improve performance
s9.outro: We do not use cross-site tracking, advertising trackers, or fingerprinting technologies.
s9.title: 9. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

privacy.translationNote: This policy is maintained in English. The Bangla version is provided for convenience; if the two differ, the English text applies.
